seoTitle: AI Auto Reply for Facebook, Instagram & WhatsApp — No Online Store Needed
seoDescription: Smarter than an auto-reply bot: an AI employee that answers "How much?", "Is it available?", and "When are you open?" right on your page — no online store, no website. For restaurants, clinics, training centres, salons, and anyone selling through social media.
heroTitle: Smart Auto Reply — No Online Store Needed
heroSubtitle: You don't need an online store, a website, or a bot you build yourself. You need an employee that answers your customers' messages and comments on Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp — instantly, in their language, from your own information. That is what Jawab24 does: it connects to your page directly and starts working in minutes.
badge: Your page is enough — store integration is optional

questions.title: The same questions, 50 to 100 times a day
questions.intro: If you sell or offer services through social media, you answer the same messages every day:
questions.q2: "Is it available?" and "What sizes do you have?"
questions.q3: "When are you open?" and "Where are you located?"
questions.outro: Jawab24 answers all of them within seconds, around the clock, from the business info you write once — so it never invents a price or an appointment.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.step1Desc: Log in with Facebook and pick your page, or connect an Instagram account or WhatsApp Business number. No store or website is asked for.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Your prices, services, hours, locations, and the answers to your common questions — once, the way you would write them to a customer.
howItWorks.step3Desc: It answers every message and comment instantly in the customer's language, and turns serious conversations into a lead list in your dashboard.

modes.title: Two employees in one
modes.salesTitle: A sales employee — for product sellers
modes.salesText: It recommends the right product, answers price, availability, and size questions, and asks a serious buyer for their name and number so they reach you ready to close.
modes.infoTitle: An info-desk employee — for clinics, institutes, and services
modes.infoText: It answers appointments, fees, locations, and service details without asking the customer for anything — the "info" mode is built for this, and it still saves every number a customer leaves on their own to your lead list.

proof.title: The proof: an institute with no store
proof.text: Al-Fariq Al-Dimashqi is a training institute — no Salla, no Zid, no Shopify. In 90 days, Jawab24 answered 44,636 messages and comments and collected 472 leads with names and phone numbers.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Do I need an online store or a website to use Jawab24?
faq.a1: No. Jawab24 connects directly to your Facebook Page, Instagram account, or WhatsApp Business number. Salla, Zid, and Shopify integration is available for merchants who have a store — and it is entirely optional.
faq.q2: How does the AI know my prices and information?
faq.a2: From the Business Info you write once: products, prices, hours, policies, and common questions. The AI sticks to it and never answers from outside it, and low-confidence replies are held for your review instead of being sent.
faq.a3: Yes — it detects 6 Arabic dialect families (Gulf, Egyptian, Levantine, Maghrebi, Iraqi, and MSA) plus Franco-Arabic, and replies in the customer's language and dialect.
faq.q4: What about voice messages and photos?
faq.a4: It transcribes voice messages and answers them, and it reads photos (a product screenshot, for example) and answers from your info — in Messenger, Instagram, and WhatsApp DMs.
faq.a5: Every conversation that includes a phone number becomes a lead card in your dashboard, with the name, the request, and the number. In sales mode, the AI also asks serious buyers for their details itself.
faq.q6: Can I pause it or review its replies?
faq.a6: Yes. You set business hours and away messages, turn auto-reply off whenever you want, and review held replies from the dashboard or the mobile app.
